partners.mechanism_chain: FGFR1 (HGNC:354) —DISRUPTS→ MAPK signaling pathway (WP:WP449); MAPK signaling pathway (WP:WP449) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); PIK3R1 (HGNC:9732) —DISRUPTS→ PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (WP:WP1070); PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (WP:WP1070) —LEADS_TO→ Short stature (HP:0004325); PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (WP:WP1070) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal facial shape (HP:0001999). #### 1. hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 2 with or without anosmia  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.785)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:3688)

**Proposed mechanism:** FGFR1 (HGNC:3688) —DISRUPTS→ FGFR1 signaling pathway (GO:0048010); FGFR1 signaling pathway (GO:0048010) —LEADS_TO→ Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (HP:0000857); FGFR1 signaling pathway (GO:0048010) —LEADS_TO→ Anosmia (HP:0000371); Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (HP:0000857) —LEADS_TO→ Kallmann syndrome 1 (MONDO:0013074); Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (HP:0000857) —LEADS_TO→ Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 2 with or without anosmia (MONDO:0007844); Anosmia (HP:0000371) —LEADS_TO→ Kallmann syndrome 1 (MONDO:0013074). Disruption of the FGFR1 signaling pathway due to FGFR1 haploinsufficiency leads to hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and anosmia, manifesting as Kallmann syndrome 1 and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 2 with or without anosmia.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in FGFR1 that lead to gain-of-function or dominant-negative effects in one disease while haploinsufficiency in the other would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: Exome or genome sequencing data showing a high-frequency (e.g., >0.1%) pathogenic variant in FGFR1 associated with either disease would also challenge this hypothesis, suggesting a different underlying mechanism or a common, highly penetrant variant in the general population.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of FGFR1 in both conditions could lead to the development of targeted therapies that modulate FGFR1 signaling for the treatment of both Kallmann syndrome 1 and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 2.
